circulation_discretization.convention: Material arc coordinate s in [-L/2,L/2]; theta=acos(2*arc/L-1), decreasing pi to zero. Gamma=sum A_k sin(k theta). Weighted residual=(2/pi) sum R_i sin(k theta_i) delta_theta_i.
circulation_discretization.scope: Fourier modes are per logical lifting beam; refine mode count and structural intervals independently. Local flow defects need not vanish in a truncated series.

section_output_definitions.cm: Local chord/4 pitching-moment coefficient, including flap mixing and the actual section-normal Mach correction; excludes moment arms and apparent-mass moments.
section_output_definitions.f_aero: Circulatory plus enabled circulation-rate force projected on the physical current section normal, per current length [input F/L]. Profile drag, apparent mass and point loads are excluded.
section_output_definitions.f_reac: Distributed real-mass gravity/inertia plus apparent-mass force projected on the physical current section normal, per current length [input F/L]. Excludes point masses, engines, struts, applied point loads and support reactions.
section_output_definitions.f_reac_sampling: Network analysis: eight-point material mass quadrature with current elastic and rigid kinematics, summed per interval and divided by current length. Point masses excluded.
section_output_definitions.da_eff: (n - n_jig) dot V_relative / |V_relative| [rad], using physical section normals and total relative velocity at the bound-vortex force point. This is the documented linearized incidence change, not an exact angle difference. Undefined at zero relative speed.
section_output_definitions.sampling: Aerodynamic quantities use material Glauert midpoint stations. Inertial forces are interval averages, reported at those stations. No half-interval shift to structural nodes is applied.

lifting_airflow.scope: Relative fluid velocity at each lifting force point, including induced flow, gusts, jets and local section motion. Normal speed excludes the component along the current span axis. Local Mach uses atmospheric sound speed, independently of the selected PG Mach.
lifting_airflow.sampling: Current bound-vortex force points; these differ from the reported beam-axis strip positions.
lifting_airflow.validity: Subsonic local Mach is necessary, not sufficient for physical validity or mesh convergence. Swept lifting lines can develop growing force-point velocities under refinement.

aerodynamic_influences.ground: Current Earth pose and image plane; coefficients update when the plane changes.
aerodynamic_influences.scope: Vortex and volume velocity coefficients. Current circulation, section frames, lengths, motion, gusts, jets and loads remain active.

wake_core.rule: max(ratio * local chord, current interval length)
wake_core.scope: Lifting-surface interactions within one physical beam use zero core. Distinct physical beams and external probes/objects use the configured cores; images inherit the selected influence core.

aerodynamic_lag.apparent_mass: Retained independently of the aerodynamic-lag setting.

trefftz.convention: Frozen straight wake, infinite trailing filaments, theta-midpoint quadrature; D=-rho/2 sum(Gamma v_wake dot (wind cross delta_r)).
trefftz.scope: Lifting-surface circulation only; no body/profile/engine/apparent-mass drag or shed-wake history.

limitations: Ground images act on steady vortices, sources and doublets; local section apparent-mass tensors do not include wall corrections.

reference_flow.definition: Relative air velocity at the fixed body velocity reference: -U_origin - Omega cross r_ref + posed Earth gust. Induced flow and local elastic velocity are excluded.
reference_flow.angle_convention: Degrees: alpha=atan2(w,u), beta=atan2(-v,hypot(u,w)); undefined or roundoff-sized directions are null.

limitations: Quasi-steady snapshot with prescribed or force/moment-constrained motion; use time analysis to evolve a trajectory.
SO(3) midpoint beam discretization; refine the mesh to assess solution accuracy. ASWING discrete parity is unverified.
Rigid/pinned/roller/sprung joints, axial struts, body/point-volume flow and engine types 0/1/2 are supported.
Struts use an explicit bilateral or tension-only wire law; buckling loads are not specified by ASW input. See the numerical notes for formula ambiguities.
CDi and span efficiency use the frozen straight Trefftz wake; total CD and load balance use near-field forces, including CDi_near.
Ground images act on steady vortices, sources and doublets; local section apparent-mass tensors do not include wall corrections.

mesh_discretization.coordinates: Undeformed material arc length; theta decreases from pi to zero. Rigid position jumps contain no beam material.

limitations: Strain uses load-induced curvature relative to the jig; positive axial strain is tension.
Cshell/Nshell are offsets from the tension axis per steady eq. 28; the user guide labels them relative to the elastic axis. Executable parity is unverified.
The strain bound sums absolute axial and bending contributions. It bounds the specified rectangular extents, not an unspecified complete cross section.

Torsional shear stress assumes a thin, closed, uniform shell: torque about the elastic axis divided by twice Atshell. Transverse-shear stress, warping, normal stress and strength margins are not inferred.
Missing shell arms or nonpositive Atshell produce null material results. Negative Atshell is invalid; shell parameters do not change equilibrium.
These are element midpoint samples. Peaks at endpoints, joints and concentrated loads require local refinement; no interpolation across jumps is implied.
Sensor axes and locations follow their rigid pylons. Relative body position/velocity describe the beam anchor; GPS and inertial measurements describe the pylon tip.
Full airflow includes the implemented regularized lifting-line, volume, propulsive jet and gust fields. Near-filament/core and ASWING sensor-flow parity require independent refinement.

Structural force/moment use the inward endpoint trace and left trace at an interior anchor, in the anchor csn frame. Both adjacent traces are exported; exact ASWING trace choice at load/property jumps is unverified.
Mechanical strain and shell stress use the selected adjacent element material midpoint, whose location is reported. They are not exact nodal or pylon-tip strain measurements.
Zero airspeed makes flow angles undefined. At a vertical sensor V axis, bank/heading are undefined; Euler-angle branches are not a global attitude representation.
Selected measurements can drive scheduled feedback and differential error integrals. Full control-file index/unit mapping and arbitrary custom controller parity remain unverified.

equilibrium_state.units: Physical quantities in ASW input units; spatial rotation vectors in radians. Numerical solver scales are not stored.
limitations: This is a steady state. It contains no unsteady history or derivative state.
The source and mesh must match. Steady reuse corrects the full equilibrium; time launch validates the saved setup at zero local rates.
Local correction does not prove that a nonlinear branch is unique or that a fold has been followed.

data.model: AE-1-S primary skin1 explicit half test fixture
